Grounding & Calming Techniques

Quick techniques to help you feel present and calm during moments of anxiety.

🌬️ Breathing Exercises

4-7-8 Breathing

A simple breathing pattern that activates your body's relaxation response:

  • Breathe in through your nose for 4 counts
  • Hold your breath for 7 counts
  • Exhale slowly through your mouth for 8 counts
  • Repeat 3-4 times or until you feel calmer

Box Breathing

Steady breathing pattern that helps calm your nervous system:

  • Breathe in for 4 counts
  • Hold for 4 counts
  • Breathe out for 4 counts
  • Hold for 4 counts
  • Repeat as needed

⚓ Grounding Techniques

5-4-3-2-1 Technique

Engage your senses to bring you back to the present moment:

  • 5 things you see: Name 5 objects you can see around you
  • 4 things you touch: Feel 4 different textures
  • 3 things you hear: Listen for 3 sounds
  • 2 things you smell: Notice 2 scents
  • 1 thing you taste: Experience 1 taste

Progressive Muscle Relaxation

Systematically relax your body by tensing and releasing muscles:

  • Start with your toes and slowly work up through your body
  • Tense each muscle group for 5 seconds
  • Release and notice the relaxation
  • Move gradually to the next muscle group

🌿 Mindfulness Practices

Body Scan Meditation

A peaceful practice to connect with your body and release tension:

Lie down comfortably and slowly bring awareness through each part of your body, from toes to head. Notice sensations without judgment. This practice takes 10-15 minutes.

Mindful Observation

Choose an object and observe it closely for several minutes. Notice:

  • Its colors and patterns
  • Its texture and weight
  • How light plays on its surface
  • Any details you haven't noticed before

💬 Quick Self-Talk

Affirmations for Anxiety

Repeat these when you need reassurance:

  • "This feeling is temporary and will pass"
  • "I am safe in this moment"
  • "I have gotten through difficult moments before"
  • "My body knows how to relax"
  • "I am doing my best, and that is enough"

⏰ Use What Works for You

Different techniques work for different people at different times. Try several and notice which ones help you feel:

  • More grounded in the present
  • More physically relaxed
  • Less anxious thoughts
  • More in control of your emotions
